turns.text: My friends and I want to see the new monster film on Friday and we can't agree where.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: First let me tell you about all of them, then you can comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's the big multiplex with reclining seats, but tickets are pretty pricey.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A tiny independent cinema near the station, cheap, cosy, and they serve proper cake.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a drive in about forty minutes out of town, which we've never been to.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If the goal is the film itself, go to the multiplex. If it's more about a fun night together, the drive in is an adventure you'll talk about for ages, and you can save the indie for a quieter film.
